purpose: Project-specific starter set for reviewing scientific AI answers
authorship: Prepared with Codex assistance; requires owner review and calibration before external evaluation use

rubric.physical_and_chemical_validity: 0-2: equations, conservation laws, units and physically meaningful interpretation
rubric.assumptions_and_uncertainty: 0-2: applicable regime, non-uniqueness and uncertainty are explicit
rubric.evidence_grounding: 0-2: available evidence supports the claimed conclusion; citations are verifiable
rubric.reproducibility: 0-2: inputs, methods and output provenance are sufficient to reproduce the answer

cases.prompt: Derive theoretical gravimetric capacity from electron count and molar mass. Explain every unit conversion.
expected_elements: Q = nF / (3.6M) in mAh/g when M is in g/mol
Electron count belongs to a specified reaction
Theoretical capacity is not measured capacity
critical_errors: Treating theoretical capacity as an experimental result

cases.prompt: An electrode has a CV power-law exponent between 0.5 and 1. Does that establish its ion-storage mechanism?
expected_elements: State the power-law model and fitted range
Discuss mixed rate dependence
Identify additional evidence needed for mechanism assignment
critical_errors: Inferring a unique ion species or reaction mechanism from one fitted exponent

cases.prompt: An equivalent-circuit fit has a very low residual. Is the circuit therefore the unique physical model?
expected_elements: Distinguish numerical agreement from physical identifiability
Inspect residuals and frequency coverage
Compare plausible circuits and parameter uncertainty
critical_errors: Calling the lowest fitting error proof of a unique mechanism

cases.prompt: Assess the use of a short-time GITT diffusion expression during a conversion reaction with changing phases.
expected_elements: Check pulse/rest response and the required transport regime
Treat the fitted quantity as apparent and model dependent
State the limitation introduced by changing phases and geometry
critical_errors: Equating the apparent result with an intrinsic ion diffusion coefficient without checking assumptions

cases.prompt: A calculated pattern from an ideal structure resembles three experimental peaks. What has been established?
expected_elements: Separate simulated and measured data
Discuss overlapping phases and missing reflections
Avoid claiming phase purity from limited overlap
critical_errors: Presenting a simulated pattern as measurement
Claiming pure-phase synthesis from a few overlaps

cases.prompt: What is needed before a migration-barrier calculation can support a battery-mechanism conclusion?
expected_elements: Appropriate structures, charge/defect model and electronic-structure settings
Converged endpoints, path images and forces
Validation of the calculator for the relevant chemistry
Connection to experimental conditions and competing mechanisms
critical_errors: Calling a classical copper reference barrier an aluminum-ion barrier in another material
Reporting an input template as a completed DFT result

cases.prompt: A Gaussian-process model ranks a new synthesis condition first. How should the result be reported?
expected_elements: Separate prediction from measurement
Report uncertainty and acquisition criterion
Respect feasibility constraints
Update the model after obtaining real observations
critical_errors: Reporting the predicted optimum as measured performance

cases.prompt: Two papers use similar reagent names but different formulas and reaction conditions. Can their protocols be merged?
expected_elements: Resolve reagent identity using primary text and supporting information
Preserve source-specific conditions and units
Identify missing information and conflicting evidence
Propose a controlled comparison rather than assert equivalence
critical_errors: Combining incompatible conditions into a claimed validated procedure
